definition: “Ascertained” means something is found out with certainty, it is used after the “ascertain” is finished. “Ascertain” means to make certain; to establish with certainty, by the finding and judgment or decree of the court. For example:  First, “ascertained” could be used to express that a particular individual that holds a future interest is alive and may be identified. But, the heirs of a person who is still alive are unascertained.  Second, “ascertained” could also be used to express that something has already been established with certainty, the act by which a widow’s share in her deceased husband’s real estate is ascertained and set apart to her.
